questions.explanation:
Note that (a, b) and (b, c) satisfy 0 < |x y| 1 but (a, c) does not satisfy it so 0 |x y| 1 is symmetric but not transitive.

For example,

x = 0.2, y = 0.9, z = 1.5

0 ≤ |x – y| = 0.7 ≤ 1

0 ≤ |y – z| = 0.6 ≤ 1

But |x – z| = 1.3 > 1

So, (b) is correct.
